correctness.rationale: For synchronous 3-state GH on Cr_n=K_{n,n}-M_n, every nonconstant four-periodic full state activates every vertex exactly once per four times (an always-rest vertex next to periodic excitation would activate). Assign phase p(v); local update is equivalent to excluding adjacent phase p+2 and requiring adjacent phase p-1. Cross-shore opposite-phase supports must be singleton matched pairs; coexistence forces four distinct matched indices and n=4, yielding exactly 4!=24 exceptional assignments. Otherwise each shore uses both phases of one parity, opposite shore both of other; writing s=2^n-2, r=s-2n, robust assignments count r, singleton-phase shore assignments 2n, no pair of both shores singleton compatible, yielding 2sr. Thus P4(n)=2(2^n-2)(2^n-2-2n)+24*1_{n=4} for every n>=3. Independently enumerated complete 3^(2n) microscopic dynamics for n=3,4,5 (0,192,1200). Source finite phase checker also inspected; infinite result follows from phase classification.
